neighbours.label: The first piece of a borrowed or invented name or word that the tokenizer cuts up, when context makes its ending obvious: Tolkien names (' Mel' of Melkor, ' M' of Mordor) and Korean or Japanese loanwords spelled out in that script (캐릭터 'character', 코리아 'Korea', ジーパン 'jeans'). Quiet for the native word in the same slot (한국, 역할, ズボン) and for many other fantasy names (Tatooine, Gandalf, Frodo). Also fires on an Eastern Arabic digit inside a date (٣٠-٨-٢٠١١).
neighbours.short: first piece of a split loanword / Tolkien name
neighbours.notes: Step-in reader of L31/N10108- (drop only 0.03; the label has nothing to do with the feeder's 'plays a part'). Cold mission: labelled from own tops and probes only. Fires were inconsistent in probing (cymbals 0.42 vs 0.00 in two frames). Test sentences written blind by a label-only author; solver leak (Arabic date) placed by that author.
